description: The SHELLTER database records shellfish-waste practices and perceptions of using bivalve shells in construction materials. Instituto Superior Técnico and Nofima surveyed the Algarve supply chain in April 2023 and construction or academic participants in Norway in June 2024. The article reports 112 voluntary participants across three groups. Mendeley version 1 supplies one Excel workbook free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage combines regional production and disposal information with opinions about circular use, not a common annual material-flow census. Voluntary recruitment, small groups and different national questionnaires are limitations for estimating representative adoption rates. Modellers could formulate actor preferences, waste-availability assumptions or reuse scenarios in circular-material simulations. model-odym is a related material-flow accounting resource requiring separate conversion of survey responses into quantitative flows. The two survey periods and producer roles were confirmed in repository metadata. No participant responses or workbook calculations were downloaded, and no willingness-to-adopt estimate was recalculated.
